id="brxe-rthsln" class="brxe-section bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-ntmqtz" class="brxe-container bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-rsfukk" class="brxe-block eyebrow-heading-container bricks-lazy-hidden"><p id="brxe-pjnhxj" class="brxe-text-basic eyebrow">Not Just Another Kite Trip
</p><h2 id="brxe-cztxpm" class="brxe-heading">Remote Baja, World-Class Coaching, and a Family You Haven’t Met Yet</h2></div><div id="brxe-wrqumk" class="brxe-divider horizontal"><div class="line"></div></div><div id="brxe-ivykmj" class="brxe-block width--m bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-xveaqp" class="brxe-text"><p>This isn’t your typical kite camp. Baja Wave Camp is a full-service, off-the-grid adventure to a pristine Pacific-side point break, a long, gentle, right-hand wave perfect for wave riding progression. Whether you’re learning to downloop through your first turns or carving clean lines, our expert coaches and full-support team are here to help you go beyond what you thought you could do. Board recovery, boat support, jetski assistance. We take care of everything, so you can focus on the ride, not the risk.</p>

</div></div><div id="spot" class="brxe-container width--l grid--2 grid--m-1 bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-qpweih" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><img width="1000" height="749" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=&#039;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#039;%20viewBox=&#039;0%200%201000%20749&#039;%3E%3C/svg%3E" class="brxe-image css-filter size-full bricks-lazy-hidden" alt="Default" id="brxe-fiyxuv" decoding="async" data-src="https://exotikite.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/DJI_0175.jpg" data-type="string" data-sizes="(max-width: 1000px) 100vw, 1000px" data-srcset="https://exotikite.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/DJI_0175.jpg 1000w, https://exotikite.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/DJI_0175-300x225.jpg 300w, https://exotikite.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/DJI_0175-768x575.jpg 768w" /></div><div id="brxe-cainoi" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-rhctni" class="brxe-block eyebrow-heading-container bricks-lazy-hidden"><p id="brxe-vlkhcf" class="brxe-text-basic eyebrow text--base">The Break, The Wind, The Setup
</p><h3 id="brxe-tvulcf" class="brxe-heading text--base">A Soft Sandbar Point Break with Steady Wind and Zero Crowds</h3></div><div id="brxe-uhktsj" class="brxe-text text--base"><p class="" data-start="1577" data-end="2018">Each spring, this remote stretch of the Baja Pacific coast lights up with side-offshore winds (20–25 knots in the afternoon) and clean, glassy surf in the mornings. The wave itself peels along a massive, forgiving sandbar, no reef, no rocks, and no stress. It&#8217;s ideal for learning to ride waves, and still offers more than enough juice for advanced carving, jumps, and foiling. Best of all? It’s quiet. Isolated. Real Baja.</p>
<p data-start="1577" data-end="2018"><strong data-start="2022" data-end="2077">On average, we get windy afternoons 80% of the week,</strong> with smooth surf or tow-in foil mornings.</p>
</div></div></div><div id="brxe-oasqtd" class="brxe-container text--base bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-dfywal" class="brxe-block width--l grid--3 grid--s-2 bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-qqdnjp" class="brxe-icon-box"><div class="icon"><i class="ion-md-calendar"></i></div><div class="content"><h4 style="text-align: center;">Season</h4>
<p style="text-align: center;">Spring (April-May)</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-syvnnf" class="brxe-icon-box"><div class="icon"><svg class="" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="48" height="48" stroke-width="3"><path d="M5 8h8.5a2.5 2.5 0 1 0 -2.34 -3.24"></path><path d="M3 12h15.5a2.5 2.5 0 1 1 -2.34 3.24"></path><path d="M4 16h5.5a2.5 2.5 0 1 1 -2.34 3.24"></path></svg></div><div class="content"><h4 style="text-align: center;">Avg Wind Speed</h4>
<p style="text-align: center;">20–25 knots<br /> 80%+ rideable days</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-jptjtw" class="brxe-icon-box"><div class="icon"><svg class="fill stroke" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="26.75 203.29 926.84 374.45"><path d="M407.592 403.535c-14.388 24.897-30.474 48.145-49.228 69.5-29.815 33.949-62.88 63.927-104.183 83.44-26.036 12.3-53.494 19.612-82.463 19.334-38.104-.367-73.42-11.399-106.764-29.39-10.574-5.705-20.715-12.097-30.65-18.82-8.117-5.493-9.838-14.24-4.47-21.599 4.479-6.136 12.082-7.711 19.658-3.59 4.963 2.7 9.547 6.089 14.373 9.05 24.315 14.922 49.943 26.376 78.282 31.568 40.712 7.458 78.368-.56 113.866-20.869 31.81-18.2 57.779-43.109 81.573-70.633 29.634-34.28 50.943-73.983 74.105-112.49 20.093-33.405 42.462-65.021 71.831-91.082 23.963-21.263 50.782-37.175 82.874-42.604 29.358-4.967 57.642-.792 84.968 10.698 33.7 14.17 62.124 36.027 88.41 60.926a487.168 487.168 0 0 1 34.477 36.173c5.881 6.843 6.728 13.113 2.449 19.517-6.772 10.136-12.745 12.852-21.981 9.519-9.886-3.567-19.793-6.873-30.353-7.846-28.67-2.643-61.927 18.93-69.314 55.342-7.386 36.405 1.771 68.084 22.174 97.777 15.278 22.234 34.43 39.75 59.69 49.877 19.895 7.977 40.703 11.107 62.09 10.582 41.863-1.028 81.436-12.205 120.167-27.117 4.663-1.795 9.282-3.729 14.018-5.306 8.685-2.89 16.784.854 19.551 8.822 2.691 7.749-1.24 15.545-9.421 18.89-31.354 12.822-63.412 23.353-96.782 29.525-34.582 6.396-69.112 7.61-103.394-1.955-44.021-12.285-75.65-39.957-98.023-79.113-6.628-11.601-13.099-23.445-16.811-36.181-4.56-15.646-6.669-31.95-5.388-48.372 1.155-14.812 4.597-29.161 9.337-43.28 5.389-16.052 16.328-27.712 28.922-38.05 17.051-13.999 36.598-21.514 58.905-21.115 1.43.025 2.958.431 4.592-.643-3.72-4.804-8.33-8.584-12.728-12.546-23.8-21.44-49.28-40.3-79.852-51.155-35.21-12.5-69.018-9.678-101.317 9.444-27.342 16.187-48.18 39.112-67.112 64.124-18.465 24.396-32.144 51.757-48.528 77.437-2.509 3.932-4.906 7.934-7.55 12.21z"></path></svg></div><div class="content"><h4 style="text-align: center;">Swell</h4>
<p style="text-align: center;">Sand bottom gentle right-hand point break with 3-6ft waves</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-timote" class="brxe-icon-box"><div class="icon"><i class="fas fa-star"></i></div><div class="content"><h4 style="text-align: center;">Minimum Kite Level</h4>
<p style="text-align: center;">Must be able to stay upwind on a twin tip</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-xjkano" class="brxe-icon-box"><div class="icon"><i class="ion-ios-water"></i></div><div class="content"><h4 style="text-align: center;">Water Temp</h4>
<p style="text-align: center;">57°F – 68°F <br />(14°C – 20°C)</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">We recommend a 4/3mm or  5/4mm wetsuit</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-jalckg" class="brxe-icon-box"><div class="icon"><svg class="fill stroke" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="273.25 117.09 540.31 608.79"><path d="M731.575 123.404c19.828-4.526 39.607-5.67 59.411-6.302 10.33-.33 15.203 4.486 17.528 14.599 4.939 21.474 5.806 43.264 4.496 65.045-1.92 31.908-9.159 62.855-20.087 92.865-22.988 63.125-58.393 119.17-98.91 172.247-22.047 28.883-45.644 56.452-70.165 83.272-26.218 28.677-53.643 56.16-81.662 83.03-25.484 24.439-51.65 48.17-78.43 71.206-7.828 6.733-16.027 13.091-23.38 20.31-12.404 12.179-25.418 4.665-30.153-7.56-8.2-21.173-12.415-43.403-13.64-66.191-.5-9.283.504-18.562-.072-28.462-6.988 1.566-13.408 3.098-19.868 4.439-27.927 5.796-56.058 7.185-84.411 3.854-1.944-.228-3.98.326-5.923.098-9.431-1.108-15.417-10.558-12.166-19.495 1.472-4.049 3.594-7.873 5.56-11.728 30.456-59.708 63.522-117.92 100.154-174.07 22.135-33.927 45.701-66.841 71.149-98.374 31.99-39.641 66.649-76.777 105.87-109.37 40.513-33.666 84.538-61.573 134.817-78.578 12.928-4.372 26.062-8.081 39.882-10.835m-8.07 243.633c19.845-33.134 36.445-67.763 47.746-104.773 5.991-19.623 9.834-39.684 11.596-60.167 1.462-16.995 1.223-33.897-.986-50.806-.386-2.959-1.577-3.988-4.46-3.977-3.681.014-7.291.535-10.936.865-39.883 3.616-77.197 15.818-112.494 34.266-39.254 20.517-74.026 47.32-106.135 77.661-40.105 37.898-75.296 80.068-107.53 124.743-47.77 66.21-89.038 136.384-126.603 208.794-.508.979-1.442 1.918-.71 3.304 1.728 1.255 3.795.7 5.726.728 30.978.441 61.031-4.592 89.956-15.747 6.69-2.58 12.451-1.947 17.466 2.997 4.811 4.743 5.194 10.516 2.918 16.66-.456 1.231-.68 2.563-.883 3.869-3.162 20.408-2.745 40.817.528 61.141 1.04 6.452 1.689 13.13 5.07 19.79 7.432-6.58 14.479-12.875 21.586-19.101 50.418-44.172 98.947-90.298 144.443-139.563 45.878-49.678 88.442-101.91 123.702-160.684z"></path></svg></div><div class="content"><h4 style="text-align: center;">Included Activites &amp; Gear</h4>
<p style="text-align: center;">Kiting, winging, SUP, longboards, tow-in surf foiling, yoga</p>
</div></div></div></div><div id="schedule" class="brxe-container width--l bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-blcjtm" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-sshsdc" class="brxe-block eyebrow-heading-container bricks-lazy-hidden"><p id="brxe-rqvqxk" class="brxe-text-basic eyebrow text--base">From Sunrise to Sunset

</p><h3 id="brxe-ivecfm" class="brxe-heading text--base">A Full Day of Surf, Foil, Wing & Kite (Plus Meals, Laughs, and Board Games)</h3></div><div id="brxe-vtwhkk" class="brxe-text text--base width--m"><p class="" style="text-align: center;" data-start="2298" data-end="2738">You’ll spend your days fully immersed in the elements, from dawn surf sessions to golden-hour downwinders. Every morning starts with surf or SUP. Midday is for feedback sessions, gear tuning, and connection. And the afternoons? That’s when the wind turns on and the magic happens. Each day is capped off with shared meals, stories, and laughs. This is an adventure, yes, but also a real, relaxed, family-style experience.</p>
